abilities.desc_zh: 重击喷出猛烈烈焰火海，击退敌人并施加持续燃烧。自身完全免疫燃烧效果。
abilities.desc_en: Heavy attacks spray roaring flame walls that push foes back and apply Burn. Hotlink is completely immune to Burn.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到火焰或能量攻击时，不受到伤害反而转化为自身的护甲提升与能量获取。近战对攻无惧对刀。
abilities.desc_en: Converts incoming fire and energy damage into bonus Armor and Power gain. Superior in close-quarters trades.

abilities.desc_zh: 近战猛击处于燃烧状态的敌人时，获得霸体 (Unstoppable) 并吸取目标生命值修复自身。
abilities.desc_en: Striking burning enemies grants Unstoppable and siphons health to repair his own frame.

abilities.desc_zh: 顶着喷射烈焰全速冲撞对手，施加燃烧并在 {{var_1}} 秒内造成 {{var_2}} 热能伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Charges forward shielded by flames, inflicting Burn dealing {{var_2}} Heat damage over {{var_1}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 双手喷火器 360 度环绕喷射，对周围敌人施加燃烧与破甲，削减其 {{var_3}} 护甲持续 {{var_4}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Sweeps twin flamethrowers 360 degrees, inflicting Burn and reducing Armor by {{var_3}} for {{var_4}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 将对手砸入烈焰熔炉漩涡，施加不可净化的焚毁，在 {{var_5}} 秒内造成 {{var_6}} 持续热能伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Slams the foe into an infernal vortex, applying unpurifiable Burn dealing {{var_6}} damage over {{var_5}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 与千斤顶、声波同队时，火焰伤害提升 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_1}} Fire Damage when teamed with Wheeljack or Soundwave.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛同队时，攻击力提升 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_2}} Attack Rating when paired with Starscream.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_3}} 护甲。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_3}} Armor.
